Chandan Shukla is a Senior Technology Architect with 17 years of experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale database, cloud, data engineering, and AI platforms. His work includes large-scale data engineering systems operating at petabyte scale, distributed architectures, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, cloud-native platforms, and production Data & AI solutions.

He is particularly interested in database internals, reliability engineering, distributed systems, scalable data architectures, and practical system design. Through hands-on experimentation and technical writing, he focuses on translating complex architecture and engineering concepts into production-oriented patterns that practitioners can apply in real-world systems.
